subject: math
description: Evaluate whether data are representative of the population named in a claim.
learningObjectives: Identify the population and sample in a statistical claim.
Recognize common sources of sampling bias, including convenience and voluntary response samples.
Compare random, stratified, convenience, and voluntary response sampling methods.
Evaluate whether a sample fairly supports a population claim.
Write a careful conclusion that includes both the statistic and the limits of the data.
prerequisites: Distinguish a part from a whole
Write a short explanation using evidence
